verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Compactness and monotonicity justify the uniform diagonal choices in (4)-(5); the summable tail constants make the selected smooth psh functions decrease on the fixed neighbourhood; and (5) supplies the upper estimates needed to identify their pointwise limit with u. The final sheaf argument correctly derives sequential closure of Psh_{X,1} and both inclusions in (2). Chambert--Loir--Ducros Definitions 8.1.1 and 8.1.13 and Lemma 8.1.4 match the uses made of them in the official arXiv v2 source.
